description: Infrastructures du réseau de gaz (transport, distribution) tous gestionnaires - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. Geographical location of gas distribution and transmission network infrastructures (all operators), in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region. The producers of this data are the gas network operators, and they are disseminated by the ORE Agency (dissemination of opendata distribution data), ODRÉ (dissemination of opendata transmission data). Be careful! Coverage: Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. The portal shows the English title as "Gas network infrastructure (transmission, distribution) all managers - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centre Régional Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes de l'Information Géographique. Its keywords include region-auvergne-rhone-alpes, open-data, inspire, sources-denergie, donnees-ouvertes, reseaux. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
